description.text:
【職務簡介】
此職務偏向後端軟體工程師；需負責整合機械手臂與相機及 AI 系統，並在ROS2 平台及 Linux 環境下進行開發作業。此外，此職務也須負責開發高效的後端服務（機器人控制、感知和 AI 決策），並在x86 Nvidia Jetson 等嵌入式平台上進行部署優化作業。
*產品目標為自動化控制系統，應用於工業自動化、物流機器人等領域，提供一個高效、穩定的軟體平台。
【工作內容】
1.在 ROS2 框架下設計、開發後端系統，並整合機械手臂和相機驅動。
2.在 Linux 環境下開發並優化軟體服務，以確保高效通訊與數據處理。
3.在 Nvidia Jetson 平台上進行性能優化作業。
【條件需求】
1.精通 ROS2 開發與 Linux 環境並具備 1 年以上後端開發經驗。
2.熟悉C++、Python 等程式語言。
3.熟悉Docker、機器人控制、圖像處理等。
4.擁有 Nvidia Jetson 平台或嵌入式系統開發經驗。
【加分項】
1.有機械手臂控制或自動化系統開發經驗者尤佳。
2.具備 AI 模型整合與優化經驗者尤佳。
【Job Overview】
We are looking for a skilled Backend Software Engineer to integrate robotic arms, cameras, and AI systems, focusing on development within ROS2 and Linux environments.
In addition, you will be designing and building efficient backend services to support robot control, perception, and AI-driven decision-making, with optimization for deployment on x86 and Nvidia Jetson embedded platforms.
*Our goal is to develop automation control systems, applied in industrial automation and logistics robots, providing an efficient and stable software platform.
【Responsibilities】
1.You will be responsible for designing and developing backend systems based on
the ROS2 framework, integrating robotic arm and camera drivers.
2.You will be responsible for developing and optimize software services in a Linux
environment to ensure efficient communication and data processing.
3.You will be optimizing and deploying systems on Nvidia Jetson platforms.
【Requirements】
1.Proficiency in ROS2 development and Linux environment with 1+ years of
backend development experience.
2.Familiarity with robot control, camera drivers, and image processing,
with experience in OpenCV.
3.Strong programming skills in C++ and Python.
4.Knowledge of Docker container technology and microservices architecture.
5.Experience with Nvidia Jetson platform or embedded system development.
【Preferred】
1.Experienced in robotic arm control or automation system development.
2.Expertise in AI model integration and optimization.
